regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual Life Insurance Term Plan
key_benefits: Death Benefit (Sum Assured on Death) paid as a lump sum to the nominee on death after the waiting period (or on accidental death during the waiting period); policy then terminates
Life cover for a term of up to 40 years
Flexibility of Single, Limited or Regular premium payment
High Sum Assured Rebate (HSAR), Female Life Rebate, Staff Rebate and Online/Web-aggregator discount on premium
Policy Cancellation Value (Single and Limited premium policies only)

eligibility.policy_term: Up to 40 years (exact min/max not recovered from the parse).
eligibility.note: Eligibility table did not survive the structural parse; sum assured is allowed only in multiples of Rs. 50,000 and is subject to BAUP (HSAR applies for every additional Rs. 1 lakh over Rs. 5 lakh). Numeric entry/maturity age and min/max sum assured not captured — verify against the policy document.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the policy document (electronic or otherwise) to review terms. Refund of premium less proportionate risk premium, medical-examination expenses and stamp duty; processed within 7 days.
key_terms.grace_period: 30 days for yearly/half-yearly frequency; 15 days for monthly. Cover continues during grace; due-but-unpaid premium deducted from any benefit payable.
key_terms.waiting_period: 45 days from the Date of Commencement of Risk. During the waiting period only ACCIDENTAL death is covered (Sum Assured on Death); death due to any reason is covered after the waiting period. Waiting period does not apply on revival.
key_terms.suicide_clause: Regular/Limited premium: policy void on suicide within 12 months of commencement of risk (or revival); 80% of premiums paid (excl. extra/underwriting amounts, taxes and rider premiums) refunded; not applicable to a lapsed policy. Single premium: 90% of the Single Premium refunded on suicide within 12 months of commencement of risk. No other death exclusion.
key_terms.maturity_benefit: No maturity benefit is payable under this policy.
key_terms.surrender_value: No surrender value. A Policy Cancellation Value is payable for Single and Limited premium policies only (not for Regular premium).
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits as per applicable tax laws, as amended from time to time; consult a tax consultant. Premiums shown are exclusive of GST/any applicable tax — subject to change.

claims_marketing_must_support: This is a pure-protection term plan — the only benefit is the Death Benefit; any 'money-back', 'maturity' or 'survival benefit' claim is invalid (no maturity benefit, no surrender value).
A 45-day waiting period applies: during it only accidental death is covered — any 'cover from day one' claim must be waiting-period-qualified (and the waiting period is waived only on revival).
Policy Cancellation Value exists ONLY for Single and Limited premium policies, NOT for Regular premium — must be variant-qualified.
Female Life Rebate (premium of a 3-year-younger male), HSAR, Staff and online discounts are conditional pricing features, not guaranteed benefit enhancements.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT position as a savings, investment or wealth-creation product — it is non-linked, non-participating pure term protection with no maturity value.
Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns', 'bonus', 'money-back' or 'maturity amount' language.
Do NOT imply unconditional day-one cover for all causes — non-accidental death is not covered during the 45-day waiting period.
Do NOT imply a loan or surrender value for Regular premium policies — neither is available.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — carry the 'as per applicable tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual Life Insurance Term Plan'
The 45-day waiting-period condition (only accidental death covered during the waiting period)
Standard disclaimer to read the benefit illustration and policy document for full terms and exclusions
